headline: Brazil Stocks Fall 0.75% as Dollar Surges
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa dropped 0.75% to 167,922, marking a fifth consecutive session of losses as the real slid to 5.44 per US dollar.
why: Latin America's largest stock exchange reflects local monetary conditions, foreign capital flows, and currency stability, which are critical for emerging market asset allocators.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: The US dollar strengthened against the Brazilian real to 5.44.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A strengthening US dollar typically triggers capital outflows from emerging markets, putting downward pressure on local equity indices like the Ibovespa and weakening local currencies.
